correctness.rationale: For each edge the bracket coefficient is det(X_v,X_w). The rooted-tree extension lemma works over every field. The cycle analysis treats zero nonzero coefficients, exactly one nonzero coefficient, exactly two, and at least three via triangle and subdivision. This produces all nonzero cycle roots except the one-edge support obstruction; a branch-free vertex off that edge permits a zero root. If no such root exists, choose the single nonzero cycle edge and nonzero coefficients on every attached first edge to force contradiction. Deleting a cycle edge yields a spanning-tree construction and one isolated residual bracket, giving exact width ≤2. Finite F_2/F_3 enumerations corroborate but do not prove generality. Characteristic two uses alternating determinants and needs no division by two.

value.rationale: Complete sharp classification of a natural Lie word-image invariant for every connected unicyclic graph and every field. The criterion is structural and distinguishes bare cycles and many tree-attached cycles of width one from otherwise similar unicyclic graphs of width two. The construction supplies explicit commutator witnesses and a sharp obstruction, rather than a routine formula for a single small instance. No downstream theorem is asserted.
